_about: Contrastive sibling pairs for the round-4 sibling-discrimination adapter. Each pair names two skills the adapter keeps confusing, with messages that unambiguously want one side. Every message is new — none paraphrases a bench question; the generator checks that under the category set's four collision rules. Both directions are written, because the failure is symmetric: parse for produce is as common as produce for parse.
